title.narrative: TECHNICAL SUPPORT FOR INTERNSHIPS FOR POVERTY REDUCTION AND

description.narrative: The ‘Technical Support for Internships for Poverty Reduction and Development Capacity Building’ project, implemented by UCC, aims to support the longer-term professional development of Irish-based students through experience of development work and life in a developing country. The objective is to contribute to the capacity of partner organisations and to expand the cadre of well-trained development professionals available to Irish and international development organisations. The key activities include identifying partner organisations, developing job descriptions, identifying candidates for interviews, preparing students for departure, monitoring and supporting students during placement, and debriefing upon return. (92 words)
